name: ambient
description: Claude starts each session knowing who you are and what's new in your Ambient wikis, gets the page of anyone or anything you mention, and each session becomes a short note in your wiki (and your team's, for folders you choose).

token.title: Ambient token
token.description: From the Ambient app: Settings → Work sessions → Create a token for Claude Code.

server.title: Ambient server
server.description: Leave as is unless your company runs its own Ambient.

context.title: What Ambient knows, in context
context.description: on: each session starts with who you are and what's new, and the pages of people and projects you mention are added. off: Claude looks in Ambient only when it decides to.
